title_en: The Stations of Fatima al-Zahra (peace be upon her) and Her Oppression in the Sources of the Ahl al-Sunna (Part 7)
summary: His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari analyzes the virtues and hardships of Fatima al-Zahra (peace be upon her) drawing from non-Imami sources.
series_en: Debates in Creed - The Religious Authority and the Caliphate after the Messenger
